g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B1 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 5.5 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: NO. NDE: 10 % RT of BW.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Gravity draw: vertical drop then continuous fall 1:100 to C-102 - no pockets, no rise.
7. Drop leg 2.15 m east of draw nozzle clears diesel/AGO draw nozzles below (same orientation).
8. Self-venting: line sized for <= 0.9 m/s; vapour vents back to C-101 via 8"-PG-100-093.
